verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented Smithery capability for security scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior. The only 'automatic scanning' mentioned (smithery-docs-11) is metadata discovery for the server card, an adjacent feature that earns no credit. Community reports of tool-description injection in a third-party scan of top Smithery servers come from an outside researcher, not the platform, and there is no vendor security-scanning claim for them to contradict.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
